SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno' AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND f.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno'
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND f.Percent_(_Eligible_Free_Ages_5_17) <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno' AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND f.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS s ON f.CDSCode = SUBSTR(s.cds, 1, 12)
WHERE f.County = 'Fresno' AND f.Charter Funding Type = 'Directly funded' AND s.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds 
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE frpm.County = 'Fresno' AND schools.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND satscores.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS s ON f.CDSCode = SUBSTR(s.cds, 4, LENGTH(f.CDSCode))
WHERE f.County Name = 'Fresno' AND f.Charter Funding Type = 'Directly funded' AND s.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno' AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND f.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno' AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND f.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno'
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND s.SOCType = 'Elementary Schools (Public)'
  AND f.Charter Funding Type = 'Directly funded'
  AND s.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno'
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND f.Charter Funding Type = 'Directly funded'
  AND s.SOCType = 'Elementary Schools (Public)'
  AND f.School Type = 'Elementary Schools (Public)'
  AND s.NCESDist IN (
    SELECT NCESDist
    FROM schools
    WHERE MailStreet LIKE '%Various Schools In District%'
      OR MailStrAbr LIKE '%Various Schools In District%'
  )
  AND s.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno'
  AND f.Charter Funding Type = 'Directly funded'
  AND s.SOCType = 'Elementary Schools (Public)'
  AND s.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CharterNum = f.`Charter School Number`
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno' AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND f.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CharterNum = f.`Charter School Number`
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno' AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND f.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CharterNum = f.`Charter School Number`
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno' AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND f.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
AND schools.County = 'Fresno'
AND frpm.NumTstTakr <= 250;
